'''Ursela Kuat''' was a member of [[House Kuat]] who was the principal [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] company [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] by [[311 BBY]]. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Kuat traveled in their [[Ursela Kuat's star yacht|star yacht]] along the [[Rothana Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Kuat [[Death/Legends|died]] when their [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] was destroyed by [[Gravity mine/Legends|gravity mines]] placed along the hyperlane to protect the secret Kuat Drive Yards [[Factory world/Legends|factory planet]] [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]]. Kuat's death had actually been arranged by the director's rivals on the KDY directorate, whose role would not be revealed until [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] after the [[Kuati Succession Crisis]] of 311 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] triggered by Kuat's death.<ref name="EGTWF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ursela Kuat was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTWF" />
